arguments.content:
import re

with open('unpacked/word/document.xml', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    xml = f.read()

paras = re.findall(r'<w:p[ >].*?</w:p>', xml, re.S)
headlines = []

def para_text(p):
    texts = re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>', p, re.S)
    return ''.join(texts)

for p in paras:
    text = para_text(p).strip()
    # Headline: non-empty, contains at least one letter, all uppercase
    if text and any(c.isalpha() for c in text) and text == text.upper():
        headlines.append(text)
        if '<w:u ' not in p:
            # Insert <w:u> before </w:rPr> to keep schema element order
            p_new = p.replace('</w:rPr>', '<w:u w:val="single"/></w:rPr>')
            xml = xml.replace(p, p_new)

print('Headlines underlined (%d):' % len(headlines))
for h in headlines:
    print(' -', h)

with open('unpacked/word/document.xml', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(xml)
print('Saved unpacked/word/document.xml')
